description: Keeps every pin current (docs/renovate.md). Weekly groups; yt-dlp daily. Patch and minor bumps of yt-dlp, Deno, Trivy, the base-image digests and the actions merge once CI passes; the Rust toolchain, Node, pnpm, crates, npm packages and every major wait for review.

customManagers.description: `# renovate: datasource=… depName=…` above a `*_VERSION` build argument or environment variable, with an optional `*_SHA256` below it that Renovate keeps in step (github-release-attachments).
The Rust version in the root Cargo.toml (`rust-version`), which follows rust-toolchain.toml.
The Playwright image in scripts/e2e.sh, by tag and digest.
Crates installed in CI by taiki-e/install-action (`tool: cargo-deny@X.Y.Z`).

packageRules.description: Our own image in the compose examples (compose.yaml, compose.caddy.yaml) follows a release tag; Renovate must not pin it by digest.
Crates (Cargo.toml, `=` pins, and cargo-deny in CI): one weekly group of non-major bumps, for review.
npm packages (web/ and e2e/): one weekly group of non-major bumps, for review. pnpm refuses packages published less than a day ago, so wait two days.

The Rust toolchain: rust-toolchain.toml, Cargo.toml's rust-version and the rust:<version>-slim-trixie build image move together, for review. The Mic bridge stage (debian:12) copies its toolchain from the Dockerfile's `toolchain` stage, one of these rust image lines.
Node: .node-version and the node:<version>-trixie-slim frontend image move together, for review.
pnpm: both packageManager fields and the Dockerfile's PNPM_VERSION move together, for review.
Playwright: @playwright/test in e2e/package.json and the image in scripts/e2e.sh must be bumped together (the image's browsers belong to that version), for review.
The Mic bridge's debian:12 base: the digest only. A newer Debian would raise the bridge's glibc floor (2.35, which the bridge stage checks), which was decided.
Base-image digests (debian:trixie-slim, debian:12, and a refreshed digest of the same rust, node or Playwright tag): one weekly group, merged once CI passes.
GitHub Actions SHAs, and just through setup-just: one weekly group of non-major bumps, merged once CI passes.
GitHub-hosted runner labels (runs-on) are chosen by hand.
Deno and Trivy: weekly, each bump with its checksum, merged once CI passes.
yt-dlp: calendar versions (YYYY.MM.DD), checked daily, each bump with its checksum, merged once CI passes. A new year is a major bump and waits for review.
Every major version waits for review, whatever matched above.
